All income earned or received by an individual carrying on business activities (except certain independent personal services) that does not exceed IDR 4.8 billion in a fiscal year is subject to 0.5% final income tax
Personal tax reliefs are provided for the resident individual, the individual’s spouse, and up to three dependent children.

figures.finding: The fiscal year is the calendar year; the annual return is due by 31 March 2027 (extendable by up to two months).

sources.said: Tax year: The fiscal year is the calendar year.
The annual individual income tax return is due by 31 March following the end of the relevant calendar year, but the deadline may be extended for up to two months.

figures.finding: An employer withholds PPh 21 monthly at an effective rate (TER) on gross monthly pay by PTKP category (A: single or married without dependants and the like; B; C), from 0% up to IDR 5.4 million a month in category A to 34% above IDR 1.4 billion, with a daily TER (0% to IDR 450,000 a day, 0.5% to 2.5 million) for daily workers. A resident performer, film star, director or film crew paid as a non-employee has PPh 21 withheld at the Article 17 scale on 50% of the gross fee.
figures.applies: Employees and individual service providers in Indonesia.

The employer is responsible for calculating, deducting, and remitting tax payable on employees’ salaries and other remuneration.
Payments for technical services provided by resident individuals are subject to employee income tax.

figures.finding: The employer pays 0.24%-1.74% work accident, 0.3% death, 3.7% old-age savings, 2% pension (capped) and 4% health (capped); the employee pays 2% old-age, 1% pension and 1% health (capped). Pension is not compulsory for expatriates; the schemes cover foreigners working six months or more.

value.caps: pension and health capped (amounts not stated)

sources.said: The employer contributions are 0.24% to 1.74% for work accident protection, 0.3% for death insurance, 3.7% for old age savings, and 2% (subject to a salary cap) for the pension plan. The employer contribution for the health care scheme is 4% (subject to a salary cap). The contribution to the pension plan is not mandatory for expatriates. Employed resident individuals must make social security contributions (old age savings) of 2% of monthly compensation and a pension plan contribution of 1%. Additionally, employed individuals are required to make a health care contribution of 1% of monthly compensation (subject to a monthly cap).

figures.finding: A non-resident's service fee and royalties from Indonesia bear a 20% withholding. For work, services or activities the 20% (PPh 26) is final, or the treaty rate applies.

sources.said: Tarifpemotongan Pajak Penghasilan Pasal 26 Sehubungan dengan Pekerjaan, Jasa, atau Kegiatan sebesar 20% (dua puluh persen) dan bersifat final atau sesuai dengan ketentuan persetujuan penghindaran pajak berganda
Technical service fees paid to a nonresident are subject to a 20% withholding tax, unless the rate is reduced in accordance with an applicable tax treaty.
Royalties paid to a nonresident are subject to a 20% withholding tax, unless the rate is reduced in accordance with an applicable tax treaty.

figures.finding: Royalties paid to a resident bear a 15% withholding as an advance on the year's tax.

sources.said: Royalties paid by an Indonesian taxpayer to an Indonesian resident are subject to a 15% withholding tax, which represents an advance payment of the tax liability for the income recipient.

figures.finding: A freelancer must register as a VAT entrepreneur (PKP) once taxable deliveries exceed IDR 4.8 billion in a year; the standard rate is 12% (in practice for luxury goods only).

sources.said: Entrepreneurs delivering taxable goods and/or taxable services with a value exceeding IDR 4.8 billion in a fiscal year are required to register for VAT purposes
The standard VAT rate is 12%.
